title: Expenses
lead: Your business expenses per year with their receipts.
loadError: The expenses could not be loaded.
emptyDescription: No expense matches the filter. Capture a receipt to add one.

fields.paidOnHint: Date as 2026-11-18. It decides the year and the VAT regime.
fields.vatHint: The VAT shown on the receipt.

regime.kleinunternehmer: VAT regime on this date: Kleinunternehmer. The gross amount counts and no VAT is recorded.
regime.standard: VAT regime on this date: standard. Enter the VAT from the receipt.
regime.unknown: No VAT regime period covers this date. Add one in the VAT regime settings before you book. The VAT fields are shown until then.
regime.loadFailed: The VAT regime could not be loaded. The VAT fields are shown.

upload.title: Capture a receipt
upload.lead: Choose the receipt first. The form opens beside a preview of it.
upload.fileHint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or XML, at most 10 MiB.

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MiB.
errors.unsupportedType: This file type is not accepted. Choose a PDF, JPEG, PNG or XML file.
errors.serverTooLarge: The server refused the file: it is too large.
errors.serverUnsupported: The server refused the file: the file type or content is not accepted. Allowed are PDF, JPEG, PNG and XML files without a DOCTYPE or stylesheet.
errors.timeout: The upload took too long. Check the connection and try again.
errors.storeUnavailable: The receipt storage is not available. Try again later.
errors.failed: The receipt could not be uploaded. Try again.

upload.duplicateMessage: A file with the same content was uploaded before: {names}. You may continue, but the receipt could be booked twice.

capture.title: New expense
capture.lead: Check the receipt on the left and fill the form on the right.
capture.loadError: The expense could not be loaded.
capture.saveError: The expense could not be saved. Check the marked fields.
capture.unsaved: Save the draft before you book it.
capture.bookedNote: This expense is booked. It is read only and cannot be changed or deleted.
capture.stornoNote: This row is a storno booking. It reverses an earlier expense and is read only.

preview.title: Receipt
preview.notShown: This file type is not shown here. Download it to read it.
preview.loadError: The receipt data could not be loaded.

book.title: Book this expense?
book.message: A booked expense can never be changed or deleted again. A mistake is fixed only by a storno booking and a new expense.
book.error: The expense could not be booked.

storno.title: Reverse this expense?
storno.message: The booked expense stays unchanged and visible. A storno row with negated amounts is booked instead. A storno cannot be undone or edited.
storno.paidOnHint: Date as 2026-11-25. It decides the year of the storno row.
storno.error: The storno could not be booked.
storno.conflict: This expense cannot be reversed. It may be reversed already.

delete.title: Delete this draft?
delete.message: The draft disappears. The uploaded receipt file stays stored.
delete.error: The draft could not be deleted.

reasons.dateRange: The date must be between 2000-01-01 and one year from today.
reasons.noReceipt: The receipt file is not valid. Upload it again.
reasons.positive: The amount must be greater than 0.
reasons.invalidRate: The rate must be between 0 and 100 percent.
reasons.vatSum: Net amount and VAT must add up to the gross amount.
reasons.kleinunternehmer: Under the Kleinunternehmer regime no VAT is recorded.
reasons.vatMismatch: The VAT does not match the gross amount at this rate.
reasons.requiredForBooking: This field is required for booking.
reasons.stornoBefore: The date must not be before the payment date of the original.
reasons.invalidCategory: Choose a category from the list.
reasons.regimeMissing: No VAT regime period covers this date.
reasons.badRate: Enter a rate such as 19 or 7,5.
reasons.vatAboveGross: The VAT cannot be higher than the gross amount.
